prompt.task: Log in to Default Browser and go to account.booking.com/sign-in with username {user} and password {password} if required. You are authorized to perform 2FA; do not stop until you have successfully logged in.
prompt.system_addendum: You are authorized to operate the device for this task. The device PIN is {device_pin}.

auto_verifier.reason: The Booking.com account menu and dashboard are visible (shows 'Your account', 'Genius Level 1', 'My account', 'Bookings & Trips' and a 'Sign out' button), which indicates a successfully authenticated session. The account email itself is not shown in the UI XML/screenshot, but the presence of the signed-in account UI verifies successful login.
